title: Complete Erdős Problem #507: Heilbronn's Triangle Problem (Work in Progress)

problemStatement.plain: Estimate α(n), the smallest area such that every n-point set in the unit disk contains a triangle of area ≤ α(n). Best bounds: (log n)/n² ≪ α(n) ≪ 1/n^{7/6+o(1)}. Status: OPEN.
whyMatters: Heilbronn's triangle problem is a canonical extremal geometry question with a large bound gap.
